unit.why: A single narrative: while R. Israel of Ruzhin is imprisoned by the Russian authorities, a Jewish soldier from Ruzhin arranges for him to go out to sanctify the new moon, and the relief guards are miraculously delayed until he returns.
unit.boundary_note: A stray running header ('הה"ק ר׳ ישראל מריזין ז') is embedded mid-text. The previous division ends a different item.

stories.start_quote: בעת התגולל עליו בלבולים הידועים ונכלא במאסר
stories.summary_en: During R. Israel of Ruzhin's imprisonment, a Jewish soldier from Ruzhin swaps guard duty, bribing the assigned soldier with spirits, so the tzaddik can leave the jail to sanctify the moon; the tzaddik prays for five hours while the guard fears death, and the relief soldiers arrive only after he returns, having wandered lost all night.
